newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines approves 11.7 bln peso power project.
newsitem.headline: Philippines approves 11.7 bln peso power project.

text.p: The Philippines' Board of Investments said on Monday it had approved the construction of a 11.7 billion peso gas-fired power plant by FGP Corp in northern Philippines.
FGP is a subsidiary of British Gas plc and First Philippine Holdings Corp.
The 500-megawatt power plant will source its power using natural gas from either the Camago/Malampaya gas field in central Philippines or from imported liquefied natural gas.
The first phase of the plant is expected to start commercial operation in October 2001.
Projects approved by the BOI are eligible for tax and tariff incentives.
